contract.expectation: Disabled automatic hyphenation has no auto-hyphenation candidates or intraword breaks when each word fits the measure.
A too-narrow measure still yields complete layout, exposing emergency intraword breaks without auto-hyphenation candidates.
Automatic hyphenation proposes at least one intraword break through the delegate.
Native layout consumes the source, including explicit soft hyphens, with complete range coverage.
With the offered soft-hyphen candidates allowed, every resulting break is at an allowed offset.
At a narrow measure, every break remains at the only allowed candidate (UTF-16 offset 3).
All vetoes suppress every line break, including emergency breaks.
Unconstrained native choice is recorded for comparison with a feasible selected soft-hyphen break.
A feasible requested break at explicit soft-hyphen offset 9 is selected; all lines fit 80 points and other offered candidates are vetoed.
Untracked HHHH supplies a reference width and caret offsets.
0.5-point tracking changes HHHH width by 2 points and final caret offset by 1.5 points.
A fixed NSFont horizontal text transform changes HHHH width by the requested ratio.
A fixed NSFont horizontal text transform changes HHHH width by the requested ratio.
A 10-point first-line indent sets a measurable reference edge for the initial quotation mark.
Moving the first-line indent left and applying equal positive kern to the quote moves only the quote ink by the requested amount while keeping following text ink fixed.

Justified native text has complete UTF-16 range coverage and a first line at the specified 75-point measure.

notes: Soft hyphens in the synthetic specimen expose explicit discretionary candidates; they do not validate linguistic hyphenation.
A delegate veto is not a hard prohibition when the requested constraints make wrapping infeasible; emergency breaks remain possible.
NSExpansionAttributeName is documented as unsupported with TextKit 2 in the selected SDK. A fixed NSFont horizontal transform works; automatic per-line glyph expansion was not exercised.
The first-line indent plus initial quote kern controls this opening-quote protrusion, but no documented TextKit 2 paragraph API exposes an arbitrary line-edge punctuation protrusion table.
Line-fragment character positions are caret offsets, not measured glyph ink origins.
